# RX Tracker NEXT v4.0.0-next.95

RX Records Stage Report now compares a baseline stage with multiple stages.

- Select one baseline and one or more different comparison stages. The baseline
  is excluded from All comparison stages and deselected when the baseline changes.
- Each row names the baseline immediately left of the compared stage, followed
  by adjacent dates and signed calendar days between them. Missing dates show
  Unknown. The former stage-to-today column is removed.
- Sort baseline dates or days between stages; CSV includes all matching pages.
- The wider popup uses nearly the full screen, with a synchronized horizontal
  scrollbar above wide results and keyboard scrolling support.
- Latest recorded dates on the same RX are compared in the application timezone.
  Target date filters do not restrict the baseline. Earlier targets retain negative days.

Existing RX read/export and driver-history permissions apply. No migration or
business-data rewrite. Separate staging history/archive changes are excluded.

Release preparation now runs locally: PostgreSQL lifecycle and application
regressions, CodeQL JavaScript/C# scans, Windows recovery checks, executable
and Softphone builds, package/source verification and SHA-256 checksums.
Hosted workflows are manual-only; pushes do not launch hosted builds.
Nodemailer and compatible locked dependencies are updated to clear the high
severity audit gate. Existing moderate Sequelize/UUID findings remain.

## Installation and verification

Use the published, checksummed ZIP through Project Control option 8 then 15.
Publication does not install the update. Keep the paired application/database
rollback set and production .env. Emergency rollback uses option 16.

Require healthy version 4.0.0-next.95. Refresh RX Records, choose a baseline and
multiple different stages, verify the dates/day difference and CSV, and test
horizontal scrolling. For older affected installations, follow
UPDATE-EXISTING-SERVER.bat and docs/database/COMPILED_RELEASE_UPDATES.md.
